source_note: The parent agent reviewed official Steam page visual material. No original-game screenshot or existing repository visual was passed as image input. These are original layout studies rather than pixel-accurate reproductions.

edit_history.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit the supplied original 言咒 wand-programming game UI image. Make ONLY ONE localized change to the right-middle "范围" diagram; keep the entire rest of the image pixel-consistent in layout, text, colors, art, size and style. Do not regenerate the rest of the screen.
REPLACE the existing single horizontal line of 10 range cells and its numeric labels with a compact grid of EXACTLY TWO ROWS AND FIVE COLUMNS in the same right-middle range panel.
Top row cell labels, exactly: B1 B2 B3 B4 B5.
Bottom row cell labels, exactly: F1 F2 F3 F4 F5.
The six middle cells B2, B3, B4, F2, F3, F4 have a restrained thin icy-cyan border and very faint cyan background highlight. The four outer cells B1, B5, F1, F5 keep the neutral charcoal and aged-gold style.
F3 additionally contains a clean small hollow circular ring as the anchor marker. It is the center cell of the bottom row. All 10 labels must remain clearly legible. No extra cells, no extra row, no extra column.
Use carved-stone/engraved grid styling consistent with the original. Make the 2x5 grid fit within the current range area without moving any other panel. Keep the existing "范围" title.
INVARIANTS: all four wands, all four spell rows, all word cards, all C/L/start metadata, top counters, right 火焰 illustration and semantic description, complete vertical tick axis, two empty sockets, spare words, buttons, border and background remain unchanged. No other added or removed text. Keep the full landscape screen framing unchanged.

qa.method: view_image on final copied PNG; visual inspection
passed: Range diagram is exactly two rows and five columns.
Top row is labeled B1 B2 B3 B4 B5; lower row positions match F1 F2 F3 F4 F5.
Exactly the six middle cells have cyan borders and subtle cyan highlighting.
The center cell of the lower row (F3 position) contains a hollow circular anchor marker.
All four spell sequences, C/L/start metadata, counters, inventory, buttons and fixed semantic details remain visibly consistent.
Vertical timing axis visibly includes digit 5; the earlier missing-5 QA statement was erroneous and has been corrected.
defects: The F3 position shows the required ring but its F3 text label is replaced by the ring instead of retained alongside it.
Original decorative slogans remain; they are visual ornament, not approved narrative.
Native output remains approximately 16:9 (1672x941), not mathematically exact 16:9.
qa.interpretation: Recommended successor to 05 for visual comparison. The required 2x5 structure, six-cell highlight and F3 anchor position are correct. The F3 label caveat is documented, and the two-attempt limit has been reached.

images.prompt_language: English with verbatim Simplified Chinese UI copy
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one high-fidelity complete 16:9 landscape PC game screen, ideally 2560x1440, for the original Chinese spell-programming game 言咒. This is an ORIGINAL VISUAL STUDY inspired by the compact wand-slot organization and information density associated with Noita, NOT a screenshot reproduction. Do not use its logo, characters, exact assets, mana, shuffle, wand capacity, or real-time action mechanics.
Art direction: crisp charcoal pixel-art and woodcut-engraving hybrid, thin aged golden-brown borders, carved raw-wood wands, warm paper labels, restrained orange fire and icy cyan accents. A dim teal cave is only a subtle background. Prioritize generous LARGE perfectly legible Simplified Chinese typography, clean complete UI, no cut-off text. Rich handcrafted game feel, not modern SaaS.
COMPOSITION: full screen with title bar, 15% left column of four wooden wands, 55% central spell assembly column, 30% right semantic inspector. Lower center contains spare word inventory and bottom action buttons. Top title exactly "言咒 · 法杖编排", status "法杖 4/4" and "已分配 9/12".
LEFT column title "法杖"; four selectable rows each containing a different simple carved wooden wand and labels "法杖一", "法杖二", "法杖三", "法杖四". Third row subtly selected in cyan.
CENTER title "完整法术". Exactly four horizontal complete spell rows. Each word is a separate large square slot with a simple original carved pictogram above the Chinese word. No extra empty word slots, no capacity UI. Use these exact spells and small but readable metadata:
Row 1: "伤害" "敌人"; metadata "C4  L1  起点0".
Row 2: "获得" "护甲"; metadata "C4  L1  起点1".
Row 3: "释放" "火焰"; metadata "C5  L3  起点2".
Row 4: "火焰" "伤害" "敌人"; metadata "C6  L1  起点2".
All four horizontal rows must be fully visible, with clear separation and consistent word tiles. Icons should reflect damage, enemy silhouette, gaining, shield, releasing, flame. Fire nouns glow ember orange. Third-row 火焰 selected with slim cyan outline.
Below four rows, a restrained "未分配词" tray contains ONLY three smaller square cards "获得 ×1", "护甲 ×1", "冰霜 ×1". This tray is inventory, not a battle hand.
RIGHT: permanently docked high-contrast semantic details panel, title "火焰", sublabel "名词 · 语义详情", a flame engraving and short neutral label "元素：火焰". Below this show a clearly legible "范围" diagram of EXACTLY ten discrete cells in one horizontal 10-cell line numbered 1 through 10, no extra rows. Below it, label "镶嵌" and EXACTLY two large empty square sockets. A slim vertical tick ruler on the far right titled "刻轴", numbered 0 through 8, provides a timing overview; orange and cyan bars align visually with ticks, no mana symbol. Keep all of this inside the right column, no tooltips covering central words.
BOTTOM: prominent warm-gold button "保存配置" and secondary button "返回路线".
A discreet footer "候选视觉 · 待确认" identifies this as a visual candidate.
Avoid: any English logo, Noita logo, sci-fi screens, full combat scene, hand of collectible cards, rarity gems, energy or mana numbers, shuffle, randomize, paid currency, upgrade buttons, extra spells, duplicate inventory words, unreadably tiny text. Preserve specified wording and data exactly.

qa.method: view_image on final copied PNG; visual inspection
passed: Complete landscape screen with four wands, four full spell rows, large Chinese word slots, fixed noun inspector and action buttons.
Four spell rows and C/L/start metadata match the task.
Assigned inventory 9/12 and wands 4/4 match the task.
Unassigned inventory contains only one each of 获得, 护甲, 冰霜.
Range diagram has exactly 10 cells numbered 1 through 10 and there are two empty sockets.
No mana, wand shuffle, capacity rule or live combat was introduced.
defects: The initial 1x10 range layout is not the game's 2x5 layout and has been corrected in v2.
Generator added decorative slogans not requested in the brief; these are ornament and are not approved game narrative.
Actual left column is somewhat wider than the nominal 15 percent layout target.
Native output is approximately 16:9, not mathematically exact 16:9.
qa.interpretation: Retained as the original generation. Use v2 for the corrected 2x5 range diagram. Parent reinspection confirmed the original timing axis has digit 5; the earlier missing-5 finding was a visual QA error, not an image defect.

images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one high-fidelity complete 16:9 landscape PC game screen, ideally 2560x1440, for the original Chinese spell-programming game "言咒". It is an ORIGINAL VISUAL STUDY adapting the well-known Slay-the-Spire reward-choice visual hierarchy: warm creamy banner at the top, three large central cards, darkened scene behind, confirmation or declining action below. This is NOT an original-game screenshot; do not copy its logo, character designs, card illustrations or exact assets.
Style: original antique copperplate-engraved fantasy illustrations on aged cream paper, brown wooden trim and weathered stone, ember orange and icy cyan accents, polished restrained game UI. Legible large Simplified Chinese text. Beautiful atmospheric background shows a quiet wizard campsite with a small campfire, an opened spellbook on a stone and a subtle original robed traveler seen from behind, all dimmed and out of focus enough to give the word cards unquestionable priority. Do not resemble any known Slay-the-Spire character.
TOP: small plain game title "言咒" at left. Small HUD at top right showing "生命 82/100" and "金币 10"; these are existing illustrative HUD values, NOT rewards. Tiny footer "界面示意数值 · 候选视觉" makes their illustrative status clear.
UPPER CENTER: graceful broad cream arched paper banner with exact LARGE headline "休整 · 选择一个词"; subtitle directly below "已选择拿词". Another compact instruction "选择1个加入库存".
CENTER: exactly three equally sized tall original word cards, set side by side with generous spacing and all text legible. The cards are roughly half the screen height. Each has one original engraving, a very large Chinese word title and exactly the specified category, time contribution, meaning and inventory text. These are word tokens to add to inventory, not combat cards, no rarity gems, no mana or energy symbols.
LEFT CARD text:
"印记"
"名词 · 2刻"
"目标上的可消耗标记"
"持有 0/3"
Original illustration: a small wax-like carved sigil impressed on pale stone, subtle orange glow.
CENTER CARD text:
"标记"
"动词 · 2刻"
"敌人获得2层印记"
"持有 0/3"
Original illustration: a stylus casting two glowing simple seal marks onto a faceless shadow silhouette. Center card is visibly SELECTED but NOT confirmed, with a thin warm golden-orange border, slightly brighter paper, and tiny label "已选中". All three cards remain equal size. No acquired inventory change yet.
RIGHT CARD text:
"空心的"
"形容词 · 1刻"
"元素不自动邻近施加"
"持有 0/3"
Original illustration: an elegant hollow ring cut out of a pale stone talisman with a little icy-blue edge light.
LOWER CENTER: one prominent button "确认选择", and one secondary quiet button "拒收". The words "拒收不会恢复休整机会" appear clearly beneath, as an explanatory line. This screen has already committed the rest opportunity to taking a word pack, so do not show any way to heal or return to choosing healing.
Keep all requested Chinese copy exact, readable, high-contrast, with generous card spacing and restrained ornament. Use only the requested labels. No English visible. No original IP logo, rarity gems, energy fees, collectible-card hand, battle board, real-time combat, gold reward, card upgrade, remove card, meta-progression, immediate healing, back-to-healing button, extra choices or extra cards. This is a candidate visual, not an implemented or playtested system.
